name: Enrolled Authenticator
description: A user has enrolled an authenticator (Okta's factor enrollment). An edge, not a node: Cartography's OktaUserFactor is this relationship, and everything it carries is a property of the pair.

factor_type.description: Okta's factorType for the enrollment (push, signed_nonce, webauthn, sms, call, email, token:software:totp, ...).

last_verified_at.description: When the factor was last used to verify (ISO-8601).
